from modules.catalogo_ampliado import external_delivery as ext


def test_app_is_fail_closed():
    out=ext.dispatch_external_alert({'AlertaEventoID':1,'Canal':'APP'})
    assert out['status']=='BLOCKED_NO_CANONICAL_PUSH_PROVIDER'


def test_missing_target_is_fail_closed():
    out=ext.dispatch_external_alert({'AlertaEventoID':1,'Canal':'EMAIL','UsuarioObjetivoID':None})
    assert out['status']=='BLOCKED_NO_TARGET_USER'


def test_email_respects_preference(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ext,'_target',lambda _:{'Activo':True,'Email':'a@example.com','Celular':'999','RecibeEmailNotificaciones':False,'RecibeWhatsAppNotificaciones':True})
    out=ext.dispatch_external_alert({'AlertaEventoID':2,'Canal':'EMAIL','UsuarioObjetivoID':10})
    assert out['status']=='BLOCKED_USER_PREFERENCE'


def test_whatsapp_respects_preference(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ext,'_target',lambda _:{'Activo':True,'Email':'a@example.com','Celular':'999','RecibeEmailNotificaciones':True,'RecibeWhatsAppNotificaciones':False})
    out=ext.dispatch_external_alert({'AlertaEventoID':3,'Canal':'WHATSAPP','UsuarioObjetivoID':10})
    assert out['status']=='BLOCKED_USER_PREFERENCE'


def test_email_enqueue_is_idempotent(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ext,'_target',lambda _:{'Activo':True,'Email':'a@example.com','Celular':'999','RecibeEmailNotificaciones':True,'RecibeWhatsAppNotificaciones':True})
    monkeypatch.setattr(ext,'_queue_exists',lambda _:True)
    marked=[]
    monkeypatch.setattr(ext,'_mark_generated',lambda event_id,qid:marked.append((event_id,qid)))
    out=ext.dispatch_external_alert({'AlertaEventoID':4,'Canal':'EMAIL','UsuarioObjetivoID':10,'Titulo':'X','FechaObjetivo':'2026-09-30'})
    assert out['status']=='GENERADA'
    assert out['reference']==ext._queue_id(4,'EMAIL',10)
    assert marked==[(4,out['reference'])]
